alerts.headline: Flood Warning issued September 28 at 11:23AM EDT until September 29 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Massachusetts... Taunton River Near Bridgewater affecting Bristol and Plymouth Counties. For the Taunton River...including Bridgewater...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Taunton River near Bridgewater. * WHEN...Until Tuesday evening. * IMPACTS...At 8.0 feet…
alerts.instruction: Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars through flooded areas. Additional information is available at www.weather.gov. The next statement will be issued this evening at 1130 PM EDT.

alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 28 at 7:49AM EDT until September 28 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay
alerts.description: * WHAT...Southeast winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas 2 to 4 feet. * WHERE...Nantucket Sound, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. * WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued September 28 at 2:07AM EDT until September 29 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Southern Bristol; Southern Plymouth; Southeast Providence; Eastern Kent; Bristol; Washington; Newport; Block Island
alerts.description: * WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways (4.4 to 6.7 feet Mean Lower Low Water). * WHERE...Washington, Southern Bristol MA, Southern Plymouth MA, Southeast Providence RI, Eastern Kent RI, Bristol RI, and Newport RI Counties. * WHEN...Through this evening. * IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
alerts.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
